_doc: SPD-17: round-trip cost WITH DATA. Per GET route the web calls: trips and p50/p95 ms at 0 / 1,000 / 10,000 extra rows per main table (scripts/seed-volume.cjs, local scratch DB). p95_ceiling = p95 x 1.5 (at least +50 ms). grows:true = trips rise with rows (an SPD-n backlog line each). Lower with node tools/round-trips-volume.cjs --write; never raise without the reason in the commit.
